item.title: Deltona Regional Library to Temporarily Close for Facility Improvements
item.description: Volusia County Public Library announces that Deltona Regional Library will be closed Monday, February 23, through Saturday, March 14, to allow for scheduled facility improvement projects. item.title: Post 187 continues its mission to preserve Black veterans’ legacy
item.description: After World War II, African American veterans returned home hoping for the rights and opportunities they had fought to defend. Instead, many found the same segregation and discrimination they had left behind. In DeLand, that reality became clear when Black veterans tried to join their local American Legion. According to post leaders, they were not allowed to join Post 5. […] The post Post 187 continues its mission to preserve Black veterans’ legacy first appeared on The West Volusia Beacon.

item.title: City ready to own bank property
item.description: A run-down building that was a bank along DeBary’s main street is about to change hands. Under an agreement ratified by the City Council, DeBary will take possession of the old Bank of America property at 150 S. item.title: Museum Notes: The Florida Highwaymen
item.description: The Florida Highwaymen are one of the most inspiring and uniquely Floridian stories in American art. Composed of 26 Black artists who began painting in the 1950s segregated Jim Crow Florida, these painters sought to make a living in a time where most Black men and women were relegated to underpaid field work or difficult labor jobs. item.title: Roadblock on U.S. 92 after fatal crash
item.description: A fatal car crash around 10 a.m. Feb. 19 shut down traffic on U.S. Highway 92 between LPGA Boulevard and Tomoka Farms Road, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. A 54-year-old Deltona woman traveling eastbound lost control and overturned her vehicle. This story will be updated when more information is available.
